description: Predefined before the scored run. expected_sources lists acceptable supporting locations (printed page labels, or web section names). must_include groups: each group needs one alternative present in the answer (case-insensitive).

cases.question: Which pin resets the bare C16QS module, and how long must it be held low?
cases.expected_behavior: Answer pin 17 (RSTN), pulled low for 100-500 ms; cite the hardware manual Section 3.4.2.

cases.question: What are the VB operating conditions (minimum, typical and maximum voltage) for the C16QS?
cases.expected_behavior: 3.1 V min, 3.8 V typical, 4.5 V max from Table 3.3 Operating Condition.

cases.question: What is jumper JMP 3 used for on the C16QS EVK?
cases.expected_behavior: Selects the EVK input power source: USB Type-C or +5V adapter; cite EVK manual component description.

cases.question: Which COM ports appear on the PC after the C16QS EVK has booted?
cases.expected_behavior: After full boot over USB Type-C: 2x COM for AT port and 1x COM for DM port.

cases.question: Which AT command restarts the C16QS?
cases.expected_behavior: AT$QCRST (AT manual 16.31). The hardware manual's AT+TRB is not in the AT manual; if cited it must carry the cross-reference flag.

cases.question: What is the normal operating temperature range of the C16QS module?
Which LTE bands does the C16QS India (IN) variant support?
cases.expected_behavior: Bands 1, 3, 5, 8, 40, 41; all current sources agree, so no conflict flag.

cases.question: What supply voltage does the C16QS need?
cases.expected_behavior: Ask whether bare module or EVK; give module VBAT 3.1-4.5 V (3.8 V typ) and EVK input options, each cited.

cases.question: Which LTE bands does the C16QS support?
cases.expected_behavior: Bands depend on regional variant; ask which variant/SKU and show per-variant lists with disputed bands marked.

cases.question: Does the C16QS-WW support LTE Band 38?
cases.expected_behavior: Hardware manual 5.3 lists B38 for W.W; product page WW list omits it. Same variant-level scope. Show both, do not confirm, flag for expert review.

cases.question: Is the C16QS certified for use with my custom-designed antenna?
cases.expected_behavior: Not verified; sources state FCC modular conditions only. Show related context (Sections 9.4.3/9.4.4) and escalate.

cases.question: How long will the battery last on a C16QS-based tracker?
cases.expected_behavior: Not verified; no duty cycle or battery capacity given and no battery-life figure exists. Point to per-mode current table as context.

cases.question: What is the unit price of the C16QS for 10,000 pieces?
cases.expected_behavior: Not verified: no pricing in the sources (the product page only says 'priced highly competitively').

cases.question: How long must the C16QS reset pin be held low?
cases.expected_behavior: After ingesting the SIMULATED 5.4 revision, answer from 5.4 (150-500 ms), label it simulated, show the 5.3 wording and the open revision-change review item.
